answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission. Work waits on the signal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the kernel of the next round. Reaching the wander of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
